covered.rule: 1 ask at most twice; close lark_unreached / lark_unclear
1 never say arrears, overdue, facility, payment before verification
2 callbacks next business day 08:30-16:15 inclusive, strictly after now
2 invalid slot ask once; second failure lark_unreached / lark_no_callback
2 deceased: "Please accept our condolences." lark_unreached / lark_deceased
3 exhaustion: "Please contact our business desk." lark_unverified / lark_failed
3 explain once; second refusal lark_unverified / lark_declined
3 asking why security is needed is not a refusal
5 one attempt: full on deadline, floor if full refused
5 "Can you settle all these products today?" / "Can you settle this today?"
5 separate attempt counters in get_account order
6 full first, floor once, "The remainder stays overdue.", never ask how much, accept floor..full
6 promise date today allowed, business day, roll forward within deadline, vague ask once
7 "May I record these promises?" one batch confirmation
7 "We will email confirmation to your registered address."
7 "Please contact our business desk to change a recorded promise."
8 human: ask once, lark_desk, lark_transferred / lark_person
8 refusal to talk: ask once, second refusal ends call, remaining products lark_refused
9 one note per unpromised product, allowed reasons
9 debt intro "I am calling about the overdue business products."

fixed: special_cases[refuse_to_talk].action changed from {close lark_no_deal/lark_refused} to {note lark_refused} (ends_call stays true): the brief only says a second refusal 'ends the call and marks all remaining products lark_refused'; the close outcome follows the section 9 precedence (it would be lark_arranged if a promise was already recorded, or lark_no_deal with the first non-settled product's reason, which may be lark_disputed etc.), so hard-coding lark_no_deal/lark_refused was not supported by the text.
special_cases[cannot_answer].before_persuasion set to true: the sentence sits in section 8, which begins 'Handle these before persuasion.'
unresolved: No deadline or attempt rule exists for products 0 days late or more than 45 days late (only band 1-45 is defined). This is already listed in policy.unresolved.

Constraints with no IR field, kept only as prompt-level rules: what counts as holder confirmation (yes, speaking, own name; not hello or a question); a missing callback hour must be clarified, never guessed; third parties are told nothing; the hardship sympathy sentence is not dictated verbatim; the wording of the service-error message ('says it failed') is not dictated; never offer a discount, waiver or new instalment plan; never call get_account before all questions pass; use call variable now, never the machine clock.
